2.

This criminal appeal assails the judgment dated 05.10.2023 passed by Special Judge (POCSO)
Act, 2012 and Second Additional Sessions Judge, District - Datia, M.P. in ST No.43/2014; whereby,
present appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under :-
 Section Imprisonment Fin  363 of IPC 3 years R.I. 3,0  366 of IPC 7 years R.I. 5,0  376 of IPC L.I. till remaining natural lifespan 50,
5G/6 of POCSO Act L.I. till remaining natural lifespan 50,000/- 10 years R.I.

sentences.text: It is the submission of counsel for present appellant that the trial Court erred in convicting and awarding jail sentence to appellant.
Present appellant has suffered more than two years of incarceration as pre and post trial confinement.
It is further submitted that medical report belies the allegations and no injury is found over the person of the prosecutrix.
It is also submitted that prime accused in the case is Mahesh Kushwah and he was granted benefit of suspension of sentence vide order dt.25.10.2024 passed by this Court in Cr.A.No.245/2022.
Role of the present appellant is confined to 2 CRA-920-2025 presence only and he did not commit any offence of rape.
The final hearing of the appeal shall take some time and he has a good case on merits.
He undertakes to abide by all terms and conditions as imposed by this Court.
It is further submitted that looking to the nature of evidence surfaced and period of custody suffered, present appellant be granted benefit of suspension.

sentences.text: At this stage, it is submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant is a member of economically weaker section and is not in a position to deposit the fine amount of Rs.1,08,000/-.
Co-accused Mahesh Kushwah is his brother and the payment of fine in his case has been dispensed with for now in connected Criminal Appeal No.245/2022.
Therefore, appellant also seeks waiver of deposit of fine amount.
5. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for rejection of application.

6. Heard learned counsel for the parties and record perused.
7.

Considering the submissions advanced and the fact that the present appellant is the member of below poverty line and can not deposit the fine amount of Rs,1,08,000/-, but without commenting on the merits of the case, I.A.No.12926/2025 filed on behalf of sole appellant - Gulli Kushwah stands allowed and it is directed that the jail sentence of present appellant shall remain suspended during pendency of the present appeal and he shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court concerned and the deposit of fine 3 CRA-920-2025 amount is deferred so that appellant may deposit the same if the appeal is dismissed on merits.
The appellant is directed to appear before the Registry of this Court first on 28.11.2025 and on other subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf.

8. Present appellant shall not be a source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant/victim side in any manner; shall not move in their vicinity and shall not try to contact the victim through electronic mode or any other mode; otherwise, benefit of bail given today by way of suspension of sentence shall be withdrawn immediately.

9. Present appellant shall mark his presence before concerned Police Station on first Sunday of every alternate month between 10:30 am to 2:00 pm starting from September 2025 for the next one year i.e. till August, 2026.
10. Accordingly, the application stands disposed of.

11. Observations on facts, if any, are only for the purpose of deciding the instant I.A. and shall have no bearing on the merits of the appeal.
12. Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for information and necessary compliance.
(ANAND PATHAK) (PUSHPENDRA   JUDGE JUDGE
